title: If You Could Walk Through Walls

scenes.text: What if you could walk through walls?
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 1, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: A wall is mostly empty space. Your atoms should slide straight through.
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 2, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: They never do, because electrons push electrons away before they ever touch.
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 3, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: Nothing in the wall is truly solid. It only behaves that way at your scale.
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 4, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text:
The wall never stops you.
You stop you - a billion tiny refusals, all agreeing to hold.
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 5, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for the next question.
scenes.art_prompt: if you could walk through walls - scene 6, cinematic, 3d
